name: vllm-rocm-r9700-main-wheel
description: vLLM wheel for AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700/gfx1201 built ROCm/vllm-style from the daily pytorch-rocm-r9700 base, official vllm-project/vllm main, scratch image containing the wheel plus ROCm/PyTorch ABI constraints only. ROCm/vllm currently has gfx1250/RDNA4 experimental branches but no public R9700/gfx1201 optimized branch or CI artifact, so this tracks upstream vLLM main.
